title: Turn a technical question into an animated explainer video
summary: A hackathon team built Reel Lab, where six agents research a technical question and produce a 60-second narrated, animated explainer video.
agent_role: Six agents research the question, write and narrate the script, and animate the video. People supply the question.
outcome: The team shared a demo video from the Nebius Build Week Hackathon in Berlin.
what_they_did: At a hackathon in Berlin, the poster's team built Reel Lab. It is a workspace where six agents take a technical question and research it. They then narrate and animate the answer as a short video.
how_it_went: The team posted a demo video of a 60-second explainer. No other results are given.
prompt: I want a 60-second explainer video answering: [your technical question]. First research the topic from reliable sources and list them. Then write a short narrated script for a general audience, and propose simple animated scenes for each line. Show me the script and scene plan for approval before producing narration and animation.

curation.rationale: A hackathon demo of six agents turning a technical question into a narrated animated explainer. It is a genuine multi-step agent workflow, but the post gives almost no detail beyond a video.
